DIAGNOSIS READY: Iron Deficiency Anemia (Secondary to GI Blood Loss)

Since you are a 67-year-old male with worsening fatigue and no other constitutional symptoms like weight loss or night sweats, I need to confirm your hemoglobin levels and look for signs of blood loss.
